items_all.title: MIT团队用机器学习修正误差，将两到六周天气预报准确率翻倍
items_all.summary: MIT研究人员团队在Nature发表论文，提出一个机器学习后处理层，通过从历史数据中学习现有预报模型的错误并修正其输出，将两周到六周范围的预报准确率翻倍。该模型在ECMWF的季节间预报竞赛中获第一名，首次在该时间范围内稳定超过气候学平均值，并显著改善洪水、寒潮等极端天气事件的预测；模型开源、低成本、可附加于任意预报模型，肯尼亚气象部门已接洽用于改进季风季预报。
items_all.title_original: Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out
items_all.title_en: Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out
items_all.title_zh: MIT团队用机器学习修正误差，将两到六周天气预报准确率翻倍
items_all.title_bilingual: MIT团队用机器学习修正误差，将两到六周天气预报准确率翻倍 / Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out

en.summary: A team of MIT researchers published a paper in Nature proposing a machine learning post-processing layer that learns from historical data to correct the errors of existing forecasting models, doubling forecast accuracy in the two- to six-week range. The model won first place in ECMWF's subseasonal forecasting competition, becoming the first to consistently beat climatology at that lead time and significantly improving forecasts of extreme weather events such as floods and cold waves. The model is open source, low cost, and can be attached to any forecasting model; Kenya's meteorological department has already reached out to use it to improve monsoon-season forecasts.

items_all.summary: Gemini 4 Argon于10月13日全面开放，Pro会员可在Gemini APP使用，Antigravity需100刀Ultra会员。作者实测认为其知识类专业能力强，Vals Index综合第一（68.9）且单次成本仅15.68美元，但CUA-bench仅4.83%排倒数第二；前端效果不及GPT-6 Astra，额度消耗快，中文写作味道重，整体体验糟糕，不建议订阅Ultra。

en.summary: Gemini 4 Argon became fully available on October 13. Pro members can use it in the Gemini app, while Antigravity requires the $100 Ultra membership. In the author's hands-on testing, it was strong at knowledge-heavy professional tasks, ranked first overall on Vals Index (68.9) at only $15.68 per run, but placed second-to-last on CUA-bench at just 4.83%. Its front-end results trail GPT-6 Astra, it burns through quota quickly, and its Chinese writing has a strong AI flavor. The overall experience is poor, and subscribing to Ultra is not recommended.

en.title: AI Takes Over Business Operations, in Practice: From a Single Visit Schedule to a True Business Loop
en.summary: Many teams say they want AI to take over business operations, but ultimately only get it to generate a report: data never makes it into the system, customer records are duplicated, and rules can break when you switch chat interfaces. Starting from a corporate visit, this article runs through a real closed loop: AI reads the calendar to determine whom to visit, calls a research Skill to break down the business model and on-site issues, then follows an SOP to create a customer master record, link related business, and archive the report, finally using a scheduled task to scan future schedules.

The author has open-sourced the chatgpt-fanout-queries Skill. Input a real question, and it calls the Responses API, saves the full search trail, extracts Fan-out queries, tallies search sources and final citations separately, and outputs an HTML report you can view offline.

en.summary: Everyone always asks: what can young people actually get out of learning AI? This interview documents the AI startup story of WaytoAGI campus ambassador Wu Tong and his partner Boss Crab. They leverage AI to quickly launch projects and take on commercial gigs, while holding on to a slower-paced approach to interpersonal relationships, taking a rational view of AI dependency, and reflecting on the hidden risks behind the efficiency dividend. Their story may offer young people looking to get into AI a more grounded reference and inspiration.

items_all.title: #AI #安全 #程序员 周鸿祎最近有句话挺扎的：AI 的尽头是安全 🛡️ 他最近密集谈 AI 安全，核心判断是： 风险已经从"大模型说错话"， 升级成智能体时代的"目标错位"—— 大模型没有目标，智能体有目标、会拆解、会调用工具， 这就有了"意志"，不能再当普通软件看了。 他的解法叫"以模治模"： 用算力对抗算力，用防守智能体对抗进攻智能体。 光靠人类，管不住机器速度的攻防。 还有三句狠话： "不发展才是最大的不安全"—— 安全要服…

en.title: #AI #Security #Developers Zhou Hongyi recently made a pointed remark: the endgame of AI is security 🛡️ He's been talking about AI security intensively, and his core judgment is that the risk has escalated from "large models saying the wrong thing" to "goal misalignment" in the Agent era — large models have no goals, while Agents have goals, break them down, and call tools. That gives them a "will," and they can no longer be treated as ordinary software.

en.title: Takeaways from watching the Allen-Sun Ge interview video frame by frame: Sun Ge raised the question, "Why do large models get smarter the more information you feed them?" He said the LLM's answer was that it doesn't know either — it's a black box. But when I asked an AI, the answer wasn't like that (which itself shows how prompts and AI models shape the response). Here's the answer I got: why do large models get smarter the more you "feed" them?

items_all_raw.title: #AI #安全 #程序员 周鸿祎最近有句话挺扎的：AI 的尽头是安全 🛡️ 他最近密集谈 AI 安全，核心判断是： 风险已经从"大模型说错话"， 升级成智能体时代的"目标错位"—— 大模型没有目标，智能体有目标、会拆解、会调用工具， 这就有了"意志"，不能再当普通软件看了。 他的解法叫"以模治模"： 用算力对抗算力，用防守智能体对抗进攻智能体。 光靠人类，管不住机器速度的攻防。 还有三句狠话： "不发展才是最大的不安全"—— 安全要服…

items_all_raw.title: MIT团队用机器学习修正误差，将两到六周天气预报准确率翻倍
items_all_raw.summary: MIT研究人员团队在Nature发表论文，提出一个机器学习后处理层，通过从历史数据中学习现有预报模型的错误并修正其输出，将两周到六周范围的预报准确率翻倍。该模型在ECMWF的季节间预报竞赛中获第一名，首次在该时间范围内稳定超过气候学平均值，并显著改善洪水、寒潮等极端天气事件的预测；模型开源、低成本、可附加于任意预报模型，肯尼亚气象部门已接洽用于改进季风季预报。
